title: A+ Core 2 Practice Test A
exam_focus: Core 2 (operating systems, security, software troubleshooting, operational procedures)
notes: Homemade practice; not official CompTIA items. Answers balanced A-D (scrambled, non-cyclic). Grade only after the set.

questions.stem: In the troubleshooting methodology, which step comes immediately after establishing a theory of probable cause?

choices.A: Test the theory to determine the cause

questions.stem: A workstation shows pop-ups and unknown processes; malware is suspected. What should you do first?

choices.B: Email the user's files to yourself for safekeeping

questions.stem: Where in Windows 10/11 can you disable apps that launch at sign-in?
A caller claiming to be the help desk asks for your password to 'fix your account.' This is:

choices.C: Vishing; refuse and verify via a known help-desk number

questions.stem: Which Linux command shows a detailed (long) listing of files in the current directory?
An app broke right after a Windows update yesterday. Best early recovery step?

choices.A: Uninstall the update or use System Restore to a prior point

questions.stem: Which share permission lets users create, edit, and delete files but NOT change permissions?
Which file extension is a Windows PowerShell script?
After unplugging a desktop before opening it, what helps drain residual power?

choices.A: Leave the PSU switch on and plugged in
choices.D: Hold the power button for several seconds

questions.stem: Ticket is resolved. What final step helps the next technician?

choices.A: Close the ticket with no notes
choices.C: Document findings, actions, and outcomes in the ticket

questions.stem: A standard user installs software and gets a prompt for admin credentials. What feature is this?
A user can log into any company PC with the same account. What provides this?

choices.A: A local account on each PC

questions.stem: An admin changed a Group Policy and wants it applied now on a client. Which command?
Which tool would you check for logged application errors and system crash details?
To perform a clean boot by disabling non-Microsoft services, which tool is classically used?
Which Linux command changes a file's permissions?
The 3-2-1 backup rule recommends:
Evidence of a policy violation is collected from a laptop. What tracks who handled it and when?
While repairing a PC you see a spreadsheet of customer SSNs on the desktop. Best action?

choices.A: Copy it to your USB for backup
choices.C: Post a screenshot to the ticket
choices.D: Don't open or copy it; keep it confidential and follow PII policy

questions.stem: Windows fails to boot after a power outage. Which built-in option should you try first?
